fields.acceptance: New tests in internal/api and/or internal/workflow, plus a testscript under cmd/rhiza/testdata/script: in a plan run whose review visit journals {"findings":[]}, the run moves from review to fresh and check (and on to gate) without starting a critic session; a round with findings still goes to the critic; both built-in plan and plan-milestone workflows route this way (a workflow test reads both files); rhiza run verdict with {"verdicts":[]} still exits non-zero. Run: go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... ./internal/workflow/... -run <the new tests>, and go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/<the new script>; regenerate describe-golden if a request type changes.
fields.statement: In the plan workflows (plan and plan-milestone), after the review step the run goes to the critic only when the latest review round holds at least one finding; a clean round (no findings) goes straight to fresh, then check, with no critic session, and rhiza run verdict still refuses an empty verdicts list.
